correctness.rationale: Unique four-gap parametrization and exact 14-monomial rational identity yield G=N/D with degree 16/22. Monic denominator makes the period criterion exact in the integral rank-22 quotient ring. Coprimality resultants 864,32,144,36 handle all primes >=5; binomial coefficients in cyclotomic neighborhoods prove sharp exponents. Exact modular gcd reductions give mod-2 period 48 and mod-3 period 54, and reproduced quotient-ring certificates establish primitive lifting at 2 and 3; CRT handles composites. The self-contained checker verifies generating identities, modular gcd, primitive coefficients, and 29 finite moduli. Computations are finite certificates supporting explicitly proved general valuation lemmas.

originality.rationale: The directly relevant 2024 preprint and its 2025 journal version state an order-22 recurrence as conjecture and give a conjectural period table; only three low-modulus periodic congruences are proved. The new result proves the rational generating function, determines the exact least period for all prime powers and composites, and makes explicit the incorrect two table entries. The existing general results cited for ordinary unweighted restricted partitions are not implications for this second-elementary-symmetric weighted sum. Semantic literature and mathematical-record comparisons have not uncovered equivalent or dominating statements; unindexed related work remains possible.
